Risk: Crypto implementation flaw
Mitigation: Vetted primitives only, cryptographer review, known-answer and property tests, fuzzing, audit, bug bounty

Risk: Post-quantum overclaim
Mitigation: Label "Post-quantum protected (beta)". Wording rules

Risk: Account takeover (SIM swap, code interception)
Mitigation: Existing-device approval, recovery-key sign-in, registration lock, passkeys, alerts

Risk: Vault content leaks to gallery or other apps
Mitigation: Zero-footprint rules, no MediaStore, no loopback server, leak test harness, footprint scan

Risk: Vault PIN brute-forced on a compromised device
Mitigation: Hardware-entangled key, Argon2id, passphrase option, escalating lockout

Risk: User loses PIN or recovery key
Mitigation: Recovery kit, drills, warnings. Not recoverable by design

Risk: Backup corruption or rollback
Mitigation: Manifest hashes, versions, restore drills, counter

Risk: Push unreliable on aggressive phones
Mitigation: Health check, OEM guides, generic fallback

Risk: Pakistan OTT licensing or encryption demands
Mitigation: Counsel, region-pinned storage, no plaintext on servers

Risk: Store policy rejection (child safety, disguised icon, media permission, foreground service)
Mitigation: Self-certify, user-chosen icons only, Photo Picker first, correct service types

Risk: Abuse: spam, scams, CSAM
Mitigation: Requests inbox, rate limits, on-device detection, franked reports, human review

Risk: Solo developer overload
Mitigation: Scope tiers, hire cryptographer and backend engineer

Risk: Cost blowout (relay, storage, push)
Mitigation: Peer-to-peer first, quotas, offload, measure per user

Risk: On-device AI unavailable on low-end phones
Mitigation: Tiers, hidden controls, small bundled models

Risk: Model licence not allowing commercial use
Mitigation: Allow only permissive licences, record each in the model manager

Risk: Supply-chain compromise
Mitigation: Pin versions, two-week-old releases only, `cargo deny`, SBOM, audits

Risk: Metadata visible before sealed sender
Mitigation: Short queues, scrubbed logs, minimal records, ship sealed sender in v1

Risk: Screen-share privacy leak
Mitigation: Single-app picker, notification hiding, secure windows blank, pause

Risk: Screenshot or camera capture of ephemeral content
Mitigation: Honest labels. No promise of prevention

Risk: Slow on 4 GB phones
Mitigation: Budgets, lite mode, tiered visuals

Risk: FFI or native crashes across OS versions
Mitigation: Test matrix, crash tooling, staged rollout

Risk: Check-in timer fails (phone dead)
Mitigation: Server-held scheduled message with heartbeat, clear limits

Risk: Name or trademark conflict
Mitigation: Search and file, backup names

Risk: Key loss when moving phones without backup
Mitigation: Setup wizard, nag, linked-device history sync

Risk: Legal exposure from intruder photo or recording
Mitigation: Off by default, local only, consent text, counsel

Risk: Data residency and privacy-law mismatch
Mitigation: Region pinning, GDPR-level privacy

Risk: Insider or admin abuse
Mitigation: No plaintext, least privilege, audit logs, access reviews

Risk: Denial of service
Mitigation: CDN or WAF, rate limits, queue caps

Risk: Alert fatigue and security-UI confusion
Mitigation: Severity discipline, usability tests, plain copy

Risk: Marketing overclaim
Mitigation: No "first" or "unhackable" claims without proof

Risk: Over-scoping from the v5 additions
Mitigation: No new Beta Core rows. Scope tiers unchanged. Each new row has a phase and a gate

Risk: Nearby messaging abused for spam or drains battery
Mitigation: v2 only. Rate limits, opt-in, relay budget, no relaying of media

Risk: Censorship-resilience features create legal exposure in Pakistan
Mitigation: Counsel review before NET-09 ships. No domain fronting. Neutral wording

Risk: Users expect auto-moderation to work in end-to-end encrypted groups
Mitigation: Rules run only on admin devices that are online. Honest labels (GRP-17)

Risk: Lockdown mode confuses people or hides messages they need
Mitigation: Exact change list, undo, security alerts always on

Risk: Family accounts misused for control or hidden surveillance
Mitigation: Pre-teens only, visible to the child, no message reading, no hidden mode, review with a child-safety adviser

Risk: Look-alike APKs and malware outside Play
Mitigation: Signed update manifest, shown fingerprint, official domain only (ADM-08)

Risk: Wrong prayer times or cultural missteps
Mitigation: Manual city and method choice, manual override, no location permission

Risk: Logo or name conflicts with an existing mark
Mitigation: Trademark and design-mark search before launch. Keep alternates ready

Risk: Remote wipe triggered by a hostile person
Mitigation: Only from an already-approved device, with a confirmation and a 10-minute undo for the sign-out

Risk: SOS and check-in create false confidence
Mitigation: Plain limits in copy: depends on signal and battery. Test before enabling

Risk: Usage insights feel like tracking
Mitigation: Local only, never uploaded, off in Maximum privacy preset
